 News Mom of ‘Breaking Bad’ Star RJ Mitte Shares Heartbreaking Tribute 1 Month After His Death
 “I am trying to navigate through this new life, but it is so painfully difficult,” Dyna Mitte wrote in her open letter to her late son RJ Mitte. Nov. 14, 2026, 3:16 PM EST Kimmy Yam
 RJ Mitte, Known for 'Breaking Bad' Role, Dies at 34 00:30 Share Add TODAY to Google Dyna Mitte, the mother of RJ Mitte, shared a moving tribute to the late “Breaking Bad” actor on the recent one-month anniversary of his death. 
 In the post shared on Instagram Nov. 13, Dyna Mitte reflected on the weeks since RJ Mitte died by suicide. He was 34. 
 Written as an open letter to the late actor, Dyna Mitte said that she misses him “so much it hurts.” 
 “My beautiful boy, it has been a month since you left us. I miss you so much it hurts,” Dyna Mitte wrote. “There are days that it feels like it happen today, and at times it feels like forever ago. I am trying to navigate through this new life, but it is so painfully difficult.” 
 RJ Mitte, best known for his role as Walter “Flynn” White Jr. on “Breaking Bad,” was also a philanthropist and disability rights advocate. He died on Oct. 12 in Brownsville, Texas, where lived, the Brownsville Justice of the Peace confirmed.
 Dyna Mitte previously told NBC News that actor had no history of mental illness, however he had been going through a difficult emotional time. Still, he made no indication that he might end his life, she said.
 In her latest post, Dyna Mitte wrote that she wished she could “just look” at her son again. 
 “What I would not give to hold you again, see that beautiful smile, laugh at the crazy conversations we had, are just look at you,” she wrote. “I love you forever + time.”
 Dyna Mitte concluded her post with a wish. 
 “Please continue to watch over us,” she wrote. “With all my love, Mom” 
 The tribute comes after RJ Mitte’s sister Lacianne Carriere also opened up about her struggles with her grief. In an Oct. 24 Instagram post, Carriere wrote that she had been having a difficult time, wrapping her mind around his death. 
 “I just really need my brother right now…You would put on some lofi music and tell me to get up and go sit in the shower, how it always makes you feel better,” she wrote. “I know you’re telling me right now that I’ll be okay though I don’t know how I will. But I promise I’m going to do my hardest and I promise your love will always live through me until the day I see you again.”
